overview: Michael A. Mastrobuoni presented his candidate profile for the Medford School Committee, detailing his municipal finance experience and priorities for the school district.

items.title: Michael A. Mastrobuoni Candidate Profile
items.summary: Michael A. Mastrobuoni introduced himself as a candidate for the Medford School Committee, highlighting his experience in municipal finance and outlining his goals for curriculum support, stable budgeting, and the Medford High School reconstruction project.
